title: Program: Chess v1 delivery - design closure to release (DRAFT plan v1)
description: Take the offline macOS chess app from SDDs at 0.3.1 DRAFT (no code) to a verified v1 release, following architecture 13 (steps 1-3), SWE-001 gates and docs/test-strategy.md. DRAFT plan iteration 1: nothing here is baselined or approved; all issues are deferred.

title: Risk: macOS signing/Gatekeeper/install-cli behaviour unverified (ASM-5)
description: If macOS 26 behaves differently than assumed, then packaging/install steps change. L=M C=M. Handling: mitigate - clean-machine walkthrough P412.
acceptance_criteria: Handling action recorded and status reviewed at each gate

title: Risk: EST thresholds (latency, cancel, calibration) may be missed
description: If measurement misses an EST value, then change requests to requirements and schedule slip. L=M C=M. Handling: mitigate - measure early (P322), CR not test edits.
acceptance_criteria: Handling action recorded and status reviewed at each gate

title: Risk: Design review churn - three joint review passes each found new items
description: If SDD reviews keep finding cross-document mismatches, then design closure never converges. L=M C=M. Handling: mitigate - cap at one consistency pass (T17) after Amendment 8; churn detector; escalate at second pass.
acceptance_criteria: Handling action recorded and status reviewed at each gate

title: Risk: Intel and other platforms cannot be tested (accepted CR-7.6)
description: If Intel-only defects exist, then they are found after release. L=M C=L-M. Handling: accept (already accepted by user, CR-7.6); reconfirm at G-6; report as not run.
acceptance_criteria: Handling action recorded and status reviewed at each gate

title: Risk: Stockfish 19 universal asset lacks x86_64 or UCI_Elo floor differs (ASM-3)
description: If wrong, then fallback path 8.2 and PINNED_UCI_ELO_RANGE/calibration bounds change. L=L-M C=M. Handling: mitigate - build script early (P33).
acceptance_criteria: Handling action recorded and status reviewed at each gate

title: Risk: Single human approver for all G2/G3 and gates is a bottleneck
description: If Brian is unavailable at gates, then work idles. L=M C=M. Handling: mitigate - batch requests, publish packages early, keep non-blocked parallel work.
acceptance_criteria: Handling action recorded and status reviewed at each gate

title: Risk: D-4 chessground board fails the spike
description: If selection sync/accessibility fails, then GUI switches to adapter D1 with rework. L=M C=M. Handling: mitigate - run the spike early (P41) with explicit fallback decision DD4.
acceptance_criteria: Handling action recorded and status reviewed at each gate

title: Risk: Store stored-format batch is a one-way door and the Board pass gates all store code
description: If Board findings are many or contested, then the critical path slips and Phase 3 start moves. L=M C=H. Handling: mitigate - run Board first, parallelise rules work and spikes meanwhile, batch Brian's decisions in G-1 and G-2.
acceptance_criteria: Handling action recorded and status reviewed at each gate

title: Risk: Baseline toolchain/crate versions (Rust 1.99.1, TS 7.0.2, Node 26.13.0, SDD crate list) cannot be confirmed
description: If a pinned version or crate is unavailable or has an advisory, then dependency choices change (G2). L=M C=M. Handling: mitigate - OQ-17 lookups in P1/P3 before first use; decision log.
acceptance_criteria: Handling action recorded and status reviewed at each gate

title: Gate G-6: Brian accepts verification close-out and risks, and decides on release
acceptance_criteria: Brian explicitly accepts residual risks (e.g. Intel not run) and decides release; release/publish actions are human-only.

title: Risk: No code has ever been compiled; 12k lines of SDD signatures are [UNV] sketches
description: If design signatures do not compile or crate APIs differ, then step 1-2 rework and SDD change requests grow. L=M C=H. Handling: mitigate - vertical slices, crate lookups before use (OQ-17), readiness checks, early compile of domain types.
acceptance_criteria: Handling action recorded and status reviewed at each gate

title: Release checklist: macOS releases current, FIDE Laws edition check, version pins
acceptance_criteria: Checklist completed with sources; any newer FIDE edition raises a CR (RULE-1/2/4).

title: Independent review of V&V close-out (Reviewer stance, fresh invocation)
acceptance_criteria: Review findings with severity; RVTM sample audit; different invocation from P57.

title: Verification close-out: RVTM, evidence per requirement, TBD/TBR/TBC closure, not-run list (Intel and unavailable platforms)
acceptance_criteria: Every requirement has evidence or an explicit 'not run: hardware unavailable'; RVTM coverage metrics, orphans/unverified listed; remaining TBD/TBR/TBC with owner.

title: Author as-built SRS
acceptance_criteria: As-built SRS in docs/ matching code: functions, interfaces, with trace to requirement IDs; discrepancies listed.

title: Vulnerability scan, CycloneDX SBOM + VEX, licence audit (Stockfish GPL, ECO CC0)
acceptance_criteria: cargo-deny/npm audit clean or documented not-reachable per Decision Log; SBOM lints; licence audit lists table and licences (NFR-6).

title: Non-functional checks: startup (NFR-1), network capture (NFR-4), offline E2E (PLAT-3), bundle scan, fuzzing (NFR-3)
acceptance_criteria: Each NFR check run with method and result recorded; failures raised as findings.

title: Calibration, strength and 1000-game soak on an isolated store
acceptance_criteria: Category ordering, +-150 Elo (EST TBD-8/9), >=100 games per pairing; soak completes; results reported; misses raised as CRs.

title: Visual regression for board/piece/colour themes
acceptance_criteria: Screenshot diff baselines for >=10 board, >=5 piece sets, light/dark themes.

title: Phase 5: Verification, V&V close-out and release
description: Machine-checkable acceptance so run-to-gate until the release gate. Release itself is human-only.

title: Build end-to-end suites: one scenario set replayed through CLI (PTY), browsers, desktop
acceptance_criteria: Scenarios written once, replayed on three front-ends; four browsers where available (best effort noted); results tagged with requirement IDs.

title: Gate G-5: Brian accepts Step 3 exit (GUI, desktop, packaging, TBD-18 wording)
acceptance_criteria: Brian passes/fails with the package: review verdicts, D-4 result, a11y evidence, walkthrough outcome.

title: Walk through PLAT-6 install on a clean macOS 26 Mac (closes ASM-5/TBC-10)
design: Manual, best effort per CR-7.6. Hardware: clean macOS 26 machine/user account.
acceptance_criteria: Brian performs the walkthrough, records the steps and Gatekeeper behaviour; results fed back via systems-engineer.

title: Packaging: universal build, ad-hoc signing, bundled Stockfish and licences, chess install-cli
acceptance_criteria: Both architectures build (lipo -info), bundle holds Stockfish 19 arm64+x86_64, COPYING and ECO CC0 notice included, install-cli works on dev Mac. Intel execution not run.

title: Adversarial code review of desktop-tauri (Reviewer stance, fresh invocation)
acceptance_criteria: Findings and verdict recorded.

title: Implement desktop-tauri shell: IPC transport, windowing, sidecar engine, single data dir
acceptance_criteria: Per SDD-desktop-tauri; same GUI suite runs in the shell; no network except loopback; sidecar naming per OQ-11.

title: Adversarial code review of the UI (Reviewer stance, fresh invocation)
acceptance_criteria: Findings and verdict recorded.

title: Implement accessibility: ARIA grid overlay, announcements, WCAG 2.2 AA theme contrast
acceptance_criteria: axe clean; contrast-ratio unit test per theme (UI-7); announcement wording per approved TBD-18 sample; VoiceOver script prepared for manual run.

title: Implement UI management screens: setup, profiles, players, stats, history, analysis, import/export, settings
acceptance_criteria: All UC screens present; stats match seeded data; import conflict flows incl. ECO and archive size message; component tests.

title: Implement UI play screens: board, clocks, move list, rewind, takeback, promotion, draw/resign
acceptance_criteria: Reducer tests; scripted mixed-input sequences keep one selection state; clocks/rewind behaviours per test-strategy focus areas; component tests.

title: Implement UI foundation: app shell, CoreClient over WebSocket, generated protocol types, theme system
acceptance_criteria: ESLint/strict tsc clean; CoreClient contract tests against server; themes follow system appearance; no remote resource references.

title: Draft screen-reader announcement wording (TBD-18) for Brian's review
acceptance_criteria: Sample wording set covering UI-6 events; submitted to Brian; Brian's review is part of G-5.

title: Check Tauri sidecar naming for universal target (OQ-11)
acceptance_criteria: Answer against pinned Tauri version with evidence tag.

title: Decide D-4 outcome: adopt chessground or fall back to adapter D1
design: Options: adopt / fallback. Recommendation after spike.
acceptance_criteria: Brian decides (G2) from the spike report; recorded in decision log.

title: Spike D-4 (OQ-9): chessground board behind the Board contract with accessible keyboard overlay (2-day timebox)
design: Skills: unit-testing, implementation-design-1016. Starts after skeleton; runs early to retire the D-4 risk. Needs Node 26.13.0.
acceptance_criteria: Pass/fail report: selection sync across mouse/drag/touch/keyboard/typed (api.state.selected == BoardModel.selected), overlay alignment, axe clean, sizes 480x320..5120x2880; recommendation adopt or fall back to study option D1. Also runs the OQ-10 browserslist check.

title: Phase 4: GUI, desktop shell and packaging (architecture step 3)
description: Board spike, UI, Tauri, packaging. review-each: human wants to see look and feel.

title: Gate G-4: Brian accepts Step 2 exit (including any G2/G3 deviations)
design: Human gate. Pre-gate full compliance check.
acceptance_criteria: Brian passes/fails: core integration green, fault-injection evidence, review findings dispositioned, stored formats as approved at G-2.

title: Desk review (G1) of step 2 conformance; raise G2 items
acceptance_criteria: Conformance of crates to SDD, edges, 5.7; deviations that are G2/G3 listed for Brian, none self-approved.

title: Measure ASM-2 timings and NFR-8 input latency; propose decisions or change requests
acceptance_criteria: Measurements on the baseline Mac with method stated; EST values updated through the decision log; any miss raised as a change request (not by editing tests).

title: Cross-process and system integration tests (CLI + server concurrency, version mismatch, reset voiding, fault injection)
acceptance_criteria: Tests per test-strategy integration level: concurrent access, PLAT-5 mismatch refusal, reset-with-live-game in another process, unfinished-game slots across processes, NFR-4 loopback-only network capture; all on isolated stores.

title: Adversarial code review of chess-server (Reviewer stance, fresh invocation)
acceptance_criteria: Findings and verdict recorded.

title: Adversarial code review of chess-cli (Reviewer stance, fresh invocation)
acceptance_criteria: Findings and verdict recorded.

title: Implement chess-server: loopback WebSocket, Host/Origin checks, static assets, config errors and signals
acceptance_criteria: Per SDD-chess-server; NFR-7 Host/Origin rejection including DNS rebinding host; exit codes; CT-SRV tests; no non-loopback bind.

title: Implement chess-cli: full-screen TUI at 80x24, resize request, terminal restore (closes ASM-4)
acceptance_criteria: All screens fit 80x24, snapshot tests; terminal restored after quit/Ctrl-C/panic; ASM-4 checked in Terminal.app and iTerm2 (manual note, best effort); keys never swallow move characters.

title: Implement chess-cli: headless and plain mode, exit codes, install-cli
acceptance_criteria: Per SDD-chess-cli: exit codes 0-4 (CLI-5), SAN/coordinate input, import --eco mapping, data-dir resolution, PTY transcript tests.

title: Decide TBD-36: exit status for TUI/plain signals, non-headless subcommands, extra setup flags
design: Must be answered before CLI code. Also consider requirements update through CR.
acceptance_criteria: Brian decides public CLI surface (G3). Options and recommendation in the package; recorded in requirements Decision Log via systems-engineer.

title: Adversarial code review of chess-app (Reviewer stance, fresh invocation)
acceptance_criteria: Findings and verdict; checks edges and 5.7 contracts; flags any G2 deviation.

title: Implement chess-app part B: import/export, analysis, computer players, calibration entry
acceptance_criteria: Two-step PGN import (D-62), stateless archive import, ECO rules, size limit message (TBD-35 EST), roster, analysis after game only, calibration entry on isolated store.

title: Implement protocol types, ts-rs generation and public-surface fitness function FF-1
acceptance_criteria: Generated TypeScript types checked in or generated in build (never hand-edited); curated pub use list enforced by FF-1; envelope shape per D-53.

title: Implement chess-app part A: Core, session actors, services, JournalCodec, EngineGateway
acceptance_criteria: Per SDD-chess-app; one Fact to one record kind; crash resume; Strict-mode spy proves no engine query for a human; unfinished-game slot rules; Core::open/open_default; coverage per strategy.

title: Adversarial code review of chess-engine (Reviewer stance, fresh invocation)
acceptance_criteria: Findings and verdict recorded.

title: Implement chess-engine: UCI process wrapper, cancel, timeouts, FakeEngine
acceptance_criteria: Per SDD-chess-engine; engine cancel <=200 ms (EST TBD-12) measured; failure recovery; FakeEngine deterministic; integration test against real Stockfish 19 from P33; no engine->app edge.

title: Adversarial code review and failure-mode analysis of chess-store (Reviewer stance, fresh invocation)
acceptance_criteria: Findings with severity; failure-mode table; confirmation that implemented formats equal the approved batch; verdict.

title: Implement chess-store part C: backup, restore with journal replay, archive support, FaultPlan fault injection
acceptance_criteria: Automatic backup cadence/retention (D-35); restore replays all retained journals; FaultPlan kill/power-loss/store-unavailable tests prove no completed move lost (NFR-2); failure injection per failure-mode table.

title: Implement chess-store part B: per-game journal, flush-before-ack, leases and heartbeats, multi-process coordination
acceptance_criteria: Journal records per arch 7.6 table; content_hash fields; lease 2 s / process 10 s / analysis 10 s heartbeat; stale lease takeover; two-process tests; stored format exactly as approved.

title: Close TBC-7, TBC-8, TBC-9 in requirements register
acceptance_criteria: Register entries closed with evidence from P33 via a change request/Decision Log entry; no baselined requirement text edited without CR.

title: Implement chess-store part A: DataDir, schema DDL, migrations with pre-upgrade backup, players and games access
design: Skills: unit-testing, component-testing, implementation-design-1016, data-architecture. ENTRY: G2 resolved and P31 done.
acceptance_criteria: Per SDD-chess-store as approved at G-2; DDL equals architecture 7.2; UUID-only boundary API; roster_indexes(); migration backup failure stops upgrade; integration tests on real temp-dir DB; coverage per strategy.

title: Record ASM-3 result: set PINNED_UCI_ELO_RANGE and choose arch 8.2 path
acceptance_criteria: Architecture ASM-3 and 8.2 updated as a proposal with constant value and fallback path decision; flagged for Brian if it changes calibration bounds (G2).

title: Write Stockfish 19 build/fetch script and run it once (closes ASM-3 inputs)
design: Skills: swe-governance, vulnerability-management. Outputs: build script path under repo build tooling; results note.
acceptance_criteria: Script produces a universal binary; lipo -info output recorded (TBC-7); uci handshake records UCI_Elo range (TBC-8); COPYING GPL version read (TBC-9); checksums recorded. Needs Internet once (SWE-001); Brian told before the run.

title: Look up version, licence, CVE for step-2 crates (OQ-17, part 2)
acceptance_criteria: Same table as step 1 for store, engine, app, cli, server crates (SQLite binding, async runtime, WebSocket, TUI, ts-rs, etc.), plus decision on unresolved crate choices; [UNV] rows listed.

title: Spike OQ-14: flock and full-sync (F_FULLFSYNC) on macOS via std vs rustix/libc
design: Question to answer: does std give advisory file locking and a durable full sync on macOS without extra crates? Evidence [RAN].
acceptance_criteria: Timeboxed 60 min; written answer on whether std suffices; throwaway code kept OUTSIDE crates/chess-store (store code is forbidden until OQ-16 closes); result recorded for architecture 3.4.

title: Phase 3: Core services - store, engine, app, CLI, server (architecture step 2)
description: Store, engine, app, CLI, server, integration. review-each: human accepts each deliverable because stored formats (G3) are one-way.

title: Gate G-3: Brian accepts Step 1 exit
design: Human gate. Pre-gate full compliance check by PM.
acceptance_criteria: Tests green, coverage and mutation evidence, review findings dispositioned (open ones as issues or accepted risk), toolchain gates in CI-equivalent run. Brian passes or fails.

title: Desk review (G1): chess-rules and chess-domain code conform to SDD, edges and 5.7 contracts
acceptance_criteria: Desk review recorded as G1; edges verified by tool output; any G2 deviation raised to Brian, never self-approved.

title: Adversarial code review of chess-domain (Reviewer stance, fresh invocation)
acceptance_criteria: Findings with severity and evidence; verdict recorded.

title: Implement chess-domain part B: BoardGrid/BoardView, roster generation, ECO classification, stats, journal vocabulary
acceptance_criteria: Roster of 25 deterministic from seed; first_k_after; BoardGrid::from_fen; ECO normalisation rules (D-60); stats aggregates against seeded data; coverage as above.

title: Implement chess-domain part A: identity newtypes, Fact vocabulary, Game state machine, mode policy, clocks, Elo
design: Skills: unit-testing, implementation-design-1016, paradigm-profile. Needs readiness verdict T18.
acceptance_criteria: Per SDD-chess-domain as baselined at G-2: UUID PlayerId/GameId; exact-integer Elo known-value tests; mode-policy table test for every action x mode; clock logic with fake time; property tests for state invariants; >=90% coverage; mutation testing on Elo and policy.

title: Adversarial code review of chess-rules (Reviewer stance, fresh invocation)
acceptance_criteria: Findings with severity and evidence; CERT-informed (no conformance claim); coverage and fuzz evidence checked; verdict recorded. Reviewer is not the author invocation.

title: Implement chess-rules part B: SAN parse/format (uppercase-B rule), PGN, ECO tag handling, ParseMove errors
acceptance_criteria: All remaining SDD-chess-rules entities implemented; MatchedMove and error reasons as D-51/D-52; golden PGN export test (IF-1); property test parse(format(m))==m; >=90% line coverage for rules modules.

title: Create Cargo workspace skeleton, CI configuration and quality-gate scaffolding
design: Skills: swe-governance, implementation-design-1016. Gate: G1 desk review if layout deviates from 3.1. Inputs: architecture 3.1-3.4, SWE-001.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace per architecture 3.1/3.2 with only the allowed crate edges (checked by a script or cargo-deny bans); rustfmt, clippy -D warnings, cargo-deny and npm audit config; isolated CHESS_DATA_DIR test helper; build passes empty on Rust 1.99.1; no suppression without reason. Evidence: command output recorded.

title: Implement chess-rules part A: positions, FEN, move generation, draw and game-end rules, perft
acceptance_criteria: Per SDD-chess-rules: tests written first; perft suite matches published counts (start, Kiwipete, positions 3-6); rule fixtures for castling, en passant, promotion, pins, stalemate, insufficient material, threefold/fifty-move, blocked-pawn non-draw; clippy/fmt clean; requirement IDs in test names.

title: Update local toolchains to Rust 1.99.1 and Node 26.13.0 LTS
design: SWE-001 s1 says local cargo 1.89 / node 26.12.1 are older than baseline. Verify versions exist ([UNV] until installed).
acceptance_criteria: cargo --version = 1.99.1, rustc edition 2024 works, node --version = 26.13.0; clippy and rustfmt present. Brian confirms in a comment (installing on the user's machine is not delegated).

title: Phase 2: Foundation - toolchain, workspace, chess-rules, chess-domain (architecture step 1)
description: First code the human sees. Test-first core. Autonomy supervised until the first code review is accepted; propose relaxing to review-each via change request.

title: Conditional: remediate NOT-READY findings against requirements (only if a readiness verdict says so)
design: Conditional loop-back per Engineering-Process.md. Skills: se-requirements, se-change-config-management.
acceptance_criteria: Executed only if T15/T18 return NOT-READY with requirement gaps; each finding closed by a change request or clarification recorded in requirements Decision Log; otherwise this task is cancelled with a note.

title: Gate G-2: Brian approves Amendment 8 (G2/G3), closes OQ-16, and decides SDD baseline v1.0
design: Human gate. Package: amendment diff, consistency pass v0.5 results, rollback notes. Pre-gate full process-compliance check by PM.
acceptance_criteria: Brian approves or rejects, item by item: Amendment 8 stored-format batch (G3), OQ-13 edge (G2 if any), OQ-16 closed as entry condition, SDD set baselined at 1.0 (per D1). No chess-store code starts before this is resolved.

title: Detailed-design readiness check: domain, store, engine, app, cli, server, ui, desktop-tauri
acceptance_criteria: One verdict per block with conditions; NOT-READY findings routed. Records whether ASM/OQ items remaining (OQ-14, OQ-17, OQ-9, OQ-10, OQ-11) are acceptably deferred to their named steps.

title: Independent SDD consistency pass v0.5 after Amendment 8 (Reviewer stance, fresh invocation)
acceptance_criteria: Report like SDD-v0.4-consistency-pass.md: nine SDDs vs architecture; findings with severity; run ID scan. Different invocation from T16's author. Findings are limited to Major/Minor with owner and gate tier; pass count noted for churn tracking.

title: Align store, domain and app SDDs to Amendment 8 and OQ-13 ruling
design: Skills: implementation-design-1016, swe-governance. Inputs: Amendment 8 draft, OQ-13 ruling, nine SDDs. Gate G0 for text (stored format approval is G-2).
acceptance_criteria: SDD edits applied only where Amendment 8 / OQ-13 require; each edit cites the decision; Fact table, journal payloads, DDL consistent across store/domain/app/architecture 7.6; versions bumped. No scope beyond the amendment.

title: Detailed-design readiness check: chess-rules
design: Skill: detailed-design-readiness. Inputs: docs/design/SDD-chess-rules.md, requirements RULE-*, IF-*, architecture 3.2/5.7. Output: docs/engineering/readiness-chess-rules.md.
acceptance_criteria: Verdict READY / READY-WITH-CONDITIONS / NOT-READY for chess-rules against requirements, architecture and SDD; conditions listed with owners. NOT-READY findings routed to the owning agent (see conditional remediation task).

title: Close OQ-13: source of game state for EngineGateway policy checks
design: Inputs: UF-APP-16, architecture 4.1, SDD-chess-app.md. Output: proposed text for amendment 8.
acceptance_criteria: A written ruling (options, recommendation) saying where EngineGateway obtains the state it policy-checks; any new edge in architecture 4.1 identified as G2. Consistent with 3.2 edges.

title: Look up version, licence, CVE for step-1 crates in architecture 3.4 (OQ-17, part 1)
design: Skills: architecture-governance, vulnerability-management. Output: appendix in docs/engineering/ (new file) and proposed 3.4 edits.
acceptance_criteria: Table for the crates used by chess-rules, chess-domain and workspace tooling: pinned version exists, licence (cargo-deny compatible), known advisories, MSRV vs Rust 1.99.1. Every row evidence-tagged [RAN]/[OBS]; anything not looked up stays [UNV].

title: Draft architecture Amendment 8 applying Board dispositions to D-41..D-43, section 7.6, OQ-20, OQ-22
design: Skills: architecture-governance, decision-records, data-architecture. Inputs: Board findings + G-1 dispositions, docs/architecture.md. Output edits to docs/architecture.md are an amendment on a topic branch (CLAUDE.md: amendments add, never renumber).
acceptance_criteria: Architecture amendment text (added, not renumbered) plus decision-log entries for each accepted disposition; stored-format changes enumerated as a single batch with rollback notes; OQ-16, OQ-20, OQ-22 status updated as proposals; RELEASE_NOTES entry drafted. Each G2/G3 item labelled for Brian.

title: Gate G-1: Brian dispositions Board findings (accept, fix, waive)
design: Human gate (convert to bd gate at baseline). Package: findings table, recommendation per finding, consequences. Silence is not approval.
acceptance_criteria: Every Board finding has a recorded disposition by Brian Prascher; any waiver is an explicit risk acceptance in beads. Review package published as an artifact.

title: Hold the independent Review Board pass on D-41..D-43 and Addendum A scope (OQ-16)
design: Skills: swe-governance, code-review-conformance (design review), failure-mode-analysis, decision-records. Inputs: docs/architecture.md s7.2, s7.6, s11; docs/design/SDD-chess-store.md, SDD-chess-domain.md, SDD-chess-app.md; SDD-architect-triage.md. Output path as above.
acceptance_criteria: Findings document docs/design/Board-pass-store-journal.md exists covering ALL OQ-16 scope: D-41, D-42, D-43, content_hash in GameEnd/Abort/Voided/VoidSpec, the per-kind payload table and its seven flags (arch 7.6, OQ-22), D-57, D-58, OQ-20. Each item has severity, evidence tag, verdict and proposed gate tier. Reviewer stance only; no architecture or SDD file edited.

title: Phase 1: Design closure (Review Board, amendment 8, SDD baseline)
description: Close OQ-16 entry condition for store code, resolve open design items, align SDDs, readiness checks. Autonomy supervised: stored-format (G3) and edge (G2) decisions are Brian's.

title: Decide Review Board composition and whether SDDs are baselined at 1.0
design: Inputs: architecture OQ-16, SWE-001 s3, SDD-v0.3-joint-review. Options for (a): software-engineer reviewer / systems-engineer reviewer / both. Consequence of no baseline: SDDs stay DRAFT and drift is controlled only by review passes.
acceptance_criteria: Brian answers: (a) who forms the independent Board for OQ-16 (recommended: software-engineer in Reviewer stance, fresh invocation, never the SDD or architecture author; system-architect may not review its own D-41..D-43); (b) whether SDDs become a controlled design baseline v1.0 at gate G-2 (recommended: yes). Recorded as a decision with options and consequences.
